description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Verifies a signed fact: pass the base64url canonical payload and its signature, receive valid true/false. For agents that stored a fact and must prove later that it was not altered.

payload.description: base64url of the canonical JSON (fact, source, measured_at, observed_at, value, query)

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature returned with the fact

name: fact_verify
